summary: A temporary crane near Glasgow may cause navigation aid bearing fluctuations in the 345 to 025 degree sector.
text:
VOR/DME GOW/GLASGOW 115.40MHZ CH101X THERE MAY BE OBSERVATIONS OF
DVOR BEARING FLUCTUATIONS WITHIN THE 345-025 DEG. MAG. SECTOR
RADIALS FROM THE GLASGOW VOR/DME STATION, DUE TO A TEMPORARY CRANE
IN THE VICINITY
